sveda_vidhi.definition: The process which relieves stiffness (stambha), heaviness (gaurava), and coldness (sita), and which induces sweating (sweda), is known as sveda-karma.
sveda_vidhi.pre_requisite: Must be conducted only after proper internal and external oleation (snehana). Never perform without prior snehana.

types.name: Tapa sveda
types.method: Heat palm, flat bronze pieces, sand, cloth, earthen pieces over fire and apply warmly to affected body part directly.

types.name: Upanaha sveda
types.method: Warm drug paste applied thickly on affected part; bandaged with animal skin (devoid of hair, hot potency), castor leaves, or woolen/silk cloth. Night application removed in morning; morning application removed at night.

types.name: Usma sveda
types.method: Conducted with utkarika (roti of yava, masa, eranda bija), losta, kapala, stone, leaves, grains, animal dung powder, sand, husk.

sub_types.name: Pinda sveda (Sankara sveda)
sub_types.method: Bolus of tila, masa etc. in moist woolen cloth; heated stones/iron balls immersed in vata-mitigating sour liquid then bolus formed. Body oiled first.

sub_types.name: Samstara sveda (Prastara sveda)
sub_types.method: Patient lies on hot drug pudding spread over stone/mat covered with vata-mitigating cloth.

sub_types.name: Nadi sveda
sub_types.method: Tube 1-1.5 vyama (~2-3 m) bent 2-3 times (elephant trunk shape) to restrict vapor; steam directed to oiled body.

sub_types.name: Ghanasma sveda
sub_types.method: Vatahara stems burned on stone/earth (~6ft x 2.5ft); ash removed; hot water or sour liquid sprinkled; patient lies on cloth-covered stone.

sub_types.name: Kumbhi sveda
sub_types.method: Drugs in earthen pot buried 1/3-1/2 in earth; bed over pot; red-hot iron balls dropped in; vapor foments patient.

sub_types.name: Kupa sveda
sub_types.method: Square pit (bed-width, double depth) with vatahara firewood burned; patient on bed over smoke-free pit.

sub_types.name: Kuti sveda
sub_types.method: Circular cottage; kustha/surasadi paste on walls; khadira furnaces around; patient on central bed.

sub_types.name: Jentaka sveda
sub_types.method: Special 16-arm cottage (jentaka grha); khadira/asvakarna wood burned in central hollow pillar. Post-session: wait 45 min, then hot bath and light diet. No cold water immediately after.
patient_instructions: Never leave the pial even if fainted
Exit only when proper sudation signs appear
No cold water for drinking/bathing immediately after
Wait 45 minutes, then hot water bath and light diet

sub_types.name: Pariseka sveda
sub_types.method: Drug decoctions (sigru, varana, eranda, karahja, surasa, arjaka, sirisa, vasa, vamsa, arka, malati, dasamula, vacadi gana, anupa mamsa) boiled with ghee in water/wine/milk/buttermilk. Poured through perforated earthenware over oiled body.

sub_types.name: Avagaha sveda
sub_types.method: Patient sits in tub of warm drug decoctions up to neck level.

thermal_types.note: Vagbhata incorporates Bhu sveda into Ghanasma sveda; Karsu and Holaka into Kupa sveda.

non_thermal_types.primary_indication: Vata obstructed by medo dhatu and kapha dosa

indication_dosa: Vata obstructed by meda and kapha

vital_point_caution.rule: Only mild sudation at these sites

protection_methods.eyes: Cover with lotus or lily petals
protection_methods.chest: Keep cool with cold substances, flower/pearl garlands, cold water

pre_conditions: Conduct only after internal and external oleation (snehana)
After proper digestion of previous night's food
In a place devoid of breeze
Assess disease, patient, habitat, and season first

proper_sudation.post_care: Gentle massage with vata-mitigating oils → hot water bath → oleation therapy regimen

signs: Blackish and red patches on skin
treatment: Treat as complications of poisons, alkalies, cauterization
Treat diarrhoea, vomiting, fainting as they arise

signs: No relief from stiffness or heaviness

excessive_stambhana_signs: Blackish discoloration of feet, lips, skin, hands

indications: Severe pain in hip, flanks, back, abdomen, lower jaw
contraindications: Immediately after milk, curds, unctuous substances, honey
sveda_vidhi.contraindication_exception: In emergency, mild (mrdu) sudation can be given even in above conditions.
advantages: Relieves joint stiffness; facilitates quick movement
Liquefies peripheral dosas and brings them to central body for elimination by sodhana
sveda_vidhi.cross_reference: Charaka Samhita Sutrasthana — 13 thermal + 10 non-thermal types
sveda_vidhi.contradiction_flag: FLAG-01: Astanga Sangraha lists 12 non-thermal types (adds adhvagamana, bharaharana). Caraka and AH list 10.

vamana_vidhi.definition: Expulsion of vitiated dosas through the mouth (urdhwa marga) is known as vamana. Since vitiated dosas are expelled from the body, the term virecana is also applicable.

mechanism: Emetic drug reaches heart through minute channels (srotas) via these properties
Oleation and sudation have pre-liquefied vitiated dosas in channels
Drug further liquefies dosas (usna guna) and breaks them (tiksna, vikasi gunas)
Dosas enter kostha (GIT) without sticking (like water through oiled earthenware)
Expelled through MOUTH due to agni+vayu bhuta dominance and udana vata activation

dosa_indication.primary: Kapha vitiated alone or with pitta
dosa_indication.secondary: Pitta and vata occupy place of kapha

absolute_contraindication_group.conditions_1_to_11_plus_amajwara: ALL sodhana procedures contraindicated (vamana, virecana, vasti, nasya, gandusa, dhumapana)
exceptions: Niruha vasti in 8th month of pregnancy — INDICATED

override_conditions.description: Vamana IS indicated even in all 29 contraindicated conditions when:

contraindications.contradiction_flag: FLAG-02: The word 'prayena' (in general) is used — contraindications are conditional, not absolute. VEDA AI must represent this as conditional logic, not binary.

purva_karma.name: Pre-operative procedure
steps: Normal seasons: conduct proper oleation and sudation first
Night before: kapha-stirring diet — marshy/aquatic animal meat, fish, milk, curd, black gram, sesame, vegetables, liquid foods
Morning of vamana day (after previous food digested): head bath, sandalwood paste, white clothes, flower garlands, spiritual rites
Apply oil to head and chest; gentle massage; sudation
Drink milk, buttermilk, mutton soup, sugarcane juice, thin gruel up to throat level (maximum capacity)
NEVER administer emetic drug on empty stomach

pradhana_karma.name: Main operative procedure
steps: Patient sits on chair (knee-height) facing East
Emetic drug mixed with honey and rock salt given after sanctification with hymn
Wait ~48 min (one muhurta) for vomiting to start
When chest oppression and salivation arise — encourage vomiting
Do NOT force; tickle throat with finger or lotus/lily/castor stalk
Attendant: gentle upward massage over umbilicus and back

pascat_karma.name: Post-operative care
steps: Wash hands, feet, and mouth
After 45 min: dhumapana (medicated fume inhalation)
Tambula sevana (betel chewing)
Rest in room devoid of breeze
Warm water for drinking and bathing; celibacy; no day sleep
No suppression of natural urges; no loud speaking, anger, anxiety
Avoid sunlight, cold breeze, long travel
Same evening or next morning (when hungry): hot water bath → light food (peya from red sali rice) per samsarjana krama

vamana_vidhi.maximum_limit: Until kapha expelled, OR emetic drug expelled, OR pitta appears in vomitus (pittanta).
formulation_notes: Rock salt added to all emetic formulations for liquefaction of kapha
Honey added to all emetic formulations for scraping out kapha
Emetics should be unwholesome, horrifying, ugly, foul-smelling (opposite of purgatives)

proper_emesis.name: Samyak yoga
signs: Kapha, pitta, vata expelled in succession (in that order)
Bouts start and stop naturally without inducing
Relief from symptoms; body feels light

excessive_emesis.name: Atiyoga
signs: Frothy vomiting or bloody vomiting with glistening particles

vega_parimana.endpoint: Until pitta appears (pittanta) + proper signs of emesis
vega_parimana.counting_rule: Count bouts only AFTER expulsion of the emetic drug

virecana_vidhi.definition: Expulsion of vitiated dosas through the rectum (adhomarga) is known as virecana.

dosa_indication.primary: Pitta vitiated alone or with kapha

indications.note: All vamana indications #5-16 (kustha through urdhwa roga) also apply to virecana

mrdu_kostha.description: Soft bowels; even milk can cause purgation

krura_kostha.description: Hard/costive bowels; requires even drastic purgatives (syama, snuhi, kahkustha)

purva_karma.name: Pre-operative procedure
sequence: Generally purgation only after emesis EXCEPT in costive bowel (krurakostha)
Patient must undergo oleation, sudation, then emesis — THEN virecana
Night before: mutton soup + warm, liquid, unctuous food with sour fruit juices (pomegranate); NOT kapha-stirring
Day of: after previous food fully digested, give drug early morning, after kapha-period passes
Assess kostha nature before drug selection
Give purgative drug on EMPTY STOMACH only

pradhana_karma.name: Main operative procedure
post_drug_steps: Sprinkle cold water on face (prevents vomiting)
Patient gargles with warm water; inhales scent of soil, lemon, madiphala, jasmine
Rest in room devoid of heavy breeze
Drink warm water at regular intervals to initiate urges
Do NOT suppress urges; evacuate in bed pan to measure output

pascat_karma.name: Post-operative care
steps: Same as post-vamana regimen EXCEPT dhumapana (not indicated)
Follow samsarjana krama
Fasting after virecana in 5 specific conditions (see below)
fasting_indications: Adrsta jirna lihga (digestion signs of purgative not visible)

special_cases.mandagni_krurakostha: Give ghee processed with alkalies and salts BEFORE purificatory drugs to restore agni and overcome kapha/vata.
special_cases.ruksa_bahu_anila_krurakostha: Give vasti first → then snigdha virecana with eranda taila or bindu ghrta. Remove obstructed faeces with phalavarti first.

mild_oleation_before_virecana.rule: Administer purgative after mild oleation; unctuous patients → ruksa virecana

signs: After faeces/pitta/kapha/vata: whitish or blackish liquid expelled
Or blood-colored, meat-wash colored, or fatty tissue-piece material

vega_parimana.endpoint: Until kapha appears (kaphanta) + proper signs of purgation
vega_parimana.counting_rule: Start counting from 3rd bout onward (leave first 2-3)

samsarjana_krama.name: Samsarjana krama
samsarjana_krama.definition: Process of restoration of digestive power by means of a specific regimen of diet after sodhana therapy.
samsarjana_krama.exception: Not given for: oozing of little pitta and kapha, habituated alcoholics, vata-pitta constitution (tarpana indicated instead).
samsarjana_krama.analogy: Like a small spark fed by grass growing to melt heavy metal — diminished agni grows to digest heavy food through gradual restoration.

basti_vidhi.definition: Administration of medicated drugs into the rectum by means of urinary bladder of various animals (cow, deer, goat, sheep etc.), or from the drug staying near the urinary bladder.
basti_vidhi.importance: Basti is the BEST line of treatment for vata disorders. Causes instant relief, nourishment, and completely eliminates vitiated vata dosas.
basti_vidhi.analogy: Like cloth absorbs color from kusumbha decoction, vasti dravya attracts vitiated dosas from the anointed body.
basti_vidhi.status_in_treatment: Half the treatment for almost all diseases; some acaryas consider it FULL treatment.
overall_benefits: Improves: agni, complexion, intelligence, voice, longevity
Useful: lameness, urustambha, fractures, contractures, abdominal distension, colic
Anorexia, reverse peristalsis, rectal cutting pain

asthapana_basti.mechanism: Drug enters large intestines → reaches root cause → eliminates it (like cutting tree roots kills the tree).
indications: Sukra/Anila/Mala graha (obstruction of semen, flatus, faeces)

standard_vagbhata.decoction_preparation: 20 pala (~1000g) drugs + 8 fruits madanaphala (Randia dumetorum) + 16x water → boil → reduce to 1/4

formulation.contradiction_flag: FLAG-04: Vagbhata's formula differs from 'other acaryas.' Both stored as variant_formula_1 and variant_formula_2.

asthapana_basti.heating_rule: Do NOT heat on direct fire. Heat indirectly in hot water bath.
asthapana_basti.drug_qualities: Neither too hot/cold, unctuous/dry, strong/mild, thick/thin, much/less, salty/unsalty, sour/unsour.

anuvasana_basti.definition: Medicated enema using unctuous substances (four types of snehana substances) processed with appropriate drugs. Intended for lubrication.
indications: Especially: very dry persons, increased agni, vata disorders

pre_conditions: Patient must have completed: oleation, sudation, emesis, purgation, and samsarjana krama
steps: Gentle massage + mild fomentation
Light food — neither too unctuous nor too dry
NEVER in empty stomach (drug travels upward, causes complications)
Walk 100 yards after food
Defecate/urinate if needed
Lie in LEFT LATERAL position on table
Anoint vastinetra and anus; introduce into rectum
Squeeze vastiputaka for ~30 seconds — not too fast, not too slow
Do NOT squeeze completely

pascat_karma: Withdraw vastinetra gently; tap buttock region with attendant's fist
Lie on back with pillow under legs, head lowered; await drug movement
Pass stool only when urge comes
Gentle oil massage over body especially painful regions
If oil expelled quickly → second dose can be given same session
Light food in the evening after withdrawal

withdrawal_time.no_expulsion_at_24h_with_symptoms: Remove with phalavarti or tiksna vasti
withdrawal_time.next_morning_protocol: Warm water or Sunthi + Dhanyaka processed water

repeat_schedule.standard: Every 3rd or 5th day per digestive capacity

matra_vasti.benefits: Normalizes dosas without inconvenience; gives strength; no strict regimen needed; comfortable.

uttara_basti.definition: Administered after niruha vasti (uttara = after), OR through orifices superior to anus (urethra or vagina).
uttara_basti.prerequisite: Patient must have undergone 2-3 asthapana (yoga) vasti first.

indications.females: Urinary, vaginal, and uterine cavity problems

puspanetra.shape: Round, smooth; cow-tail shape at base; kunda/sumana flower stalk shape at tip; 2 ridges

procedure_male: Bathe, eat per sneha vasti regimen, defecate/urinate
Sit on stool of knee height
Probe introduced in erect penis to locate urethral route
Puspanetra (connected to vastiputaka) introduced into urethra; squeeze well
If drug not expelled by next day → remove with phalavarti
procedure_female: Best time: During rtukala (menstrual period — uterus and os open)
Emergency (no rtukala observation needed): prolapsed uterus, uterine/vaginal pain, bleeding
Frequency: 3-4 times per 24 hours; 3 consecutive days; 3 days rest; repeat 3 days
Girls: Only 1 inch into urethral passage; NOT into uterus before menarche
uttara_basti.benefits: Mitigates vata; improves chances of conception (when given at rtukala).

vastinetra.shape: Round, smooth, straight; cow's tail shape (tapering from base to tip); 2 ridges at base

vastiputaka.primary_material: Urinary bladder of goat, sheep, pig, deer, cow, buffalo
vastiputaka.preparation: Soak in oil → wash with green gram flour (remove veins/glands) → steep in astringent decoctions → wash with water → store
alternatives: Thick cloth bag coated with beeswax

dosage_table.name: Asthapana vasti dosage by age
dosage_table.contradiction_flag: FLAG-03: Vagbhata and Caraka give different dosages for same age groups. Both stored. Flag as source-specific.

vasti_by_number.alternation_rule: NEVER give sneha OR niruha continuously. Continuous sneha → decreased agni. Continuous niruha → vata aggravation. Always alternate.

anuvasana_count_by_dosa.rule: Use odd numbers only when going beyond above counts. Even numbers only when combined with niruha.

nasya_vidhi.definition: Administration of drug through nostrils is known as nasya.
nasya_vidhi.mechanism: Nose is the gateway of the head. Drug moves up channels to singataka (junction) → spreads to head interior, channels of eyes/ears/throat → cures almost all head diseases.

virecana_nasya.drugs: Oil processed with strong drugs; paste/decoction forms; mixed with honey, rock salt, asava

brmhana_nasya.drugs: Mutton soup; blood of desert-dwelling animals; khapura (resin/gum of herbs)

samana_nasya.drugs: Oil processed with mild drugs + mutton juice/blood/milk/water. Anutaila for normal dosa state.

pradhamana_nasya.description: Powder blown through tube (6-inch tube) by attendant's mouth

dosage_table.unit: 1 bindu = liquid from 2 digits of index finger immersed in liquid

drug_form_selection.decoction_paste: Throat disorders, typhoid, excessive sleep, psychic disorders, worms, head diseases, conjunctivitis from poison, snakebite, unconsciousness
drug_form_selection.powder: Above disorders when dosas are profound/serious (fastest action)

disease_specific.vata_head_hiccup_tetanus_cervical_hoarse: Daily morning and evening for 7 days
disease_specific.other_diseases: Morning and evening on alternate days for 1 week

contraindications: After water, alcohol, artificial poison, unctuous substances, or food (or desire for these)
After head bath or desire for one
After venesection or with active bleeding
During unsuitable season, inauspicious days, cloudy sky

purva_karma: Oil massage on head and neck + sudation
pradhana_karma: Lie in room devoid of breeze; additional fomentation above clavicle
Lie supine, limbs stretched, head-end LOWERED, legs slightly raised
Warm medicine instilled into each nostril alternately (other nostril closed)
Immediately after: gentle massage on soles, palm, shoulder, neck, ears
Turn to sides; spit out entire medicine
If fainting → sprinkle cold water over body (NOT on head)
pascat_karma: After virecana nasya → administer sneha dravyas per dosa/desa/satmya
Lie supine for ~100 syllables duration (~2-3 min)
Follow with vairecanika dhuma or suitable medicated fumes

pratimarsa_nasya.action: Acts slowly; less benefit; NO complications

anutaila.name: Anutaila
anutaila.primary_use: Nasal administration (nasya); best drug of choice as head is seat of kapha and sesame oil eliminates kapha

preparation.method: Boil all drugs with 100x rainwater → reduce to 1/10th → divide into 10 parts. Boil oil 10 times, adding 1 part decoction each time. At 10th boiling add equal quantity of goat's milk. (10-fold boiling = superior method.)

overall_nasya_advantages: Skin, shoulder, neck, chest become thick, well-developed, bright
Sense organs become strong and well-functioning
Hair does not gray with regular nasal administration

nasya_vidhi.contradiction_flag: FLAG-05: Running page headers show 'Ascotananjana-Vidhi Adhyaya: 23' from page 48 — likely printing/OCR artifact; content is definitively Nasya-vidhi (Ch. 20). Verify with next chunk.

dhumapana_vidhi.definition: Inhalation of medicated fumes is known as dhumapana.
dhumapana_vidhi.purpose: Prevention and cure of disorders of vata and kapha above the shoulders.
contraindications: After consuming: fish (matsya), alcohol (madya), curd (dadhi), milk (ksira), honey (ksoudra), unctuous substances, poison
dhumapana_vidhi.contraindication_note: Even cold-potency drugs become hot after contact with fire — hence contraindicated for pitta and rakta disorders.

general: Patient sits straight; calm mind; deep breathing
Fumes inhaled through one nostril; expelled through MOUTH only
Fumes from mouth inhaled → expelled through MOUTH ONLY (NEVER through nostrils — causes vision loss)

by_dosa_location.dosas_at_nose_head: Inhale first through nostrils, then mouth
by_dosa_location.dosas_adhered_to_sites: Inhale first through mouth, then nostrils

kasaghna_dhumapana.equipment: Burning coal in earthen saucer + drug powder/paste + inverted saucer on top + tube (10 inches)
kasaghna_dhumapana.route: MOUTH only; exhale through mouth only
kasaghna_dhumapana.endpoint: Until dosas expelled or organ lightness

dhumanetra.materials: Same as vastinetra (gold, silver, copper etc.)
dhumanetra.features: Cow-tail shaped; straight; 3 compartments; smooth; slender rod inside

dhumavarti_preparation.base: Darbha reed (Desmostachya bipinnata), 12 inches; soak in water overnight
dhumavarti_preparation.drug_application: Apply drug paste for 9 inches length; dry well; reapply; dry — repeat 5 times total
dhumavarti_preparation.use: Remove reed; insert in dhumanetra; light with fire

list.note: Oils from: phala (fruit), sara (pith), medas (fat), majja (marrow), vasa (muscle fat), ghrta (ghee)

list.safety_flag: FLAG-06: Arsenic compound — requires shodhana (purification) before use. Do NOT recommend without shodhana.
FLAG-06: Arsenic compound — requires shodhana. Do NOT recommend without shodhana.

proper: Cleans impurities from heart, throat, sense organs
Mitigates vitiated dosas and their diseases

benefits_regular_use: Protection from dyspnoea, coryza, voice disorders
No nasal or oral foul smell

gandusa.definition: Holding liquid in buccal cavity without moving it for a specific period.

kavala.definition: Holding liquid in oral cavity and moving it to and fro.
kavala.difference_from_gandusa: Moving vs not moving — the ONLY difference

specific_uses.use: Hypersensitivity/loosening of teeth; vata oral diseases
Burning sensation, mouth ulcers, wounds from poisons/alkalies/cauterization
Cleans oral dirt; heals mouth ulcers; relieves burning and thirst
Bad taste, dirt, bad smell in mouth

procedure: Patient sits comfortably; room devoid of breeze but with sunlight
Mild sudation above shoulder region + oil massage on neck, cheeks, forehead
Patient concentrates on therapy; no talking during gandusa
Continue until kapha accumulates in mouth OR watery nasal/eye discharge
After gandusa: massage and sudation again
Conduct 3, 5, or 7 gargles; or until proper signs
gandusa_kavala.endpoint: Until kapha accumulates in mouth OR until patient gets watery discharge from nose and eyes.
benefits_of_kavala: Diseases of neck, head, ears, mouth, eyes

pratisarana.definition: Application of drugs inside the mouth with a finger.

mukhalepa.name: Mukhalepa
mukhalepa.application: Dry naturally; remove by moistening with water; anoint with oil after

contradiction_flags.description: Vagbhata (AH) and Caraka Samhita both describe 10 non-thermal types. Astanga Sangraha adds adhvagamana and bharaharana = 12 types total.
contradiction_flags.veda_ai_action: Cross-reference with Charaka Samhita Sutrasthana for complete validated list. Store source-specific.

contradiction_flags.veda_ai_action: MUST represent as conditional logic, NOT binary. Contraindications are relative, not absolute in all cases.
